item.description: Good morning, Jonathan. Tonight we caught four videos from your Claude and AI workflow queue. item.title: Daily Digest — Wed May 06, 2026
item.description:
Good morning, Jonathan. Tonight we caught three videos from your queue. Two of them are genuinely worth your attention — one of those is probably the most practically useful thing your playlist has surfaced in a while. The other one is a quick stop. Let's get into it.
[music]
This one is from Chase AI, and the title is a little clickbaity, but the core idea is solid. He calls it an Agentic OS — which sounds fancy, but it really just means: stop treating Claude Code like a slot machine where you pull random prompts and hope for consistent output.

item.title: Daily Digest — Tue May 05, 2026
item.description:
Good morning, Jonathan. Tonight we caught two videos from your queue. One is a tight twelve-minute framework you can apply to your prompts today — genuinely useful, not hype. The other is a longer tutorial on unlocking image and video generation inside Claude Cowork, and while the marketing angle isn't yours, the church-comms application is worth your time. Let's get into it.
[music]
The first video is from Dylan Davis, and the title is a little dramatic, but the idea holds up.

item.title: Daily Digest — Thu Apr 30, 2026
item.description:

The other is forty minutes with Anthropic's Cowork design lead, Jenny Wen, and it's the more interesting of the two by a wide margin. Let's get into it.
